dedupe_keys.name: global fault zone permeability test site database

description: This Figshare database compiles measured or reported permeability of fault zones and their surrounding rocks from sites worldwide. The Scientific Data descriptor describes 410 datasets at 521 reviewed sites and 379 locations, including geothermal, groundwater, petroleum and underground engineering contexts. The own item provides an XLSX table of permeability and site attributes plus a KMZ location file. A modeller can use the values as parameter ranges or validation checks for leakage, geothermal flow or tunnel-water simulations. Studies differ in testing method, spatial scale and fault structure; they should not be pooled into one universal permeability constant. The coordinates locate study sites, not every test interval. Figshare reports CC0 for the item. I read own repository metadata and the descriptor without opening spreadsheets, maps or PDFs. No related catalogue record with this compiled database was found. A limitation is that source studies use different test methods and spatial scales, so the values require site-specific interpretation. The database was compiled by Jacek Scibek, author of the Scientific Data descriptor.
